I would like to advise caution when reading these notes. This project began with a focused study of the postulates of quantum mechanics and reflections on its interpretation. However, I eventually incorporated study notes from courses I took as a student, as well as material from previous reviews.

Naturally, I always strive for accuracy; however, I cannot guarantee that I haven’t made a mistake in a mathematical derivation---even if I happened to arrive at the correct result. If you spot any such errors, I would be happy to be corrected. You can contact me via email at sbjhordan@gmail.com.

Despite these initial caveats, I hope you find these notes useful.
